title: Classification of Nijenhuis operators on three-dimensional multiplicative simple Bihom-Lie algebras
summary: We provide a complete classification of Nijenhuis operators on three-dimensional multiplicative simple BiHom-Lie algebras over the complex field C. Based on the classification of such algebras by Saadaoui into three families L1, L2, and L3, we derive the complete system of equations arising from the equivariance conditions and the Nijenhuis identity. We provide explicit matrix representations of all solutions, including all degenerate parameter cases.
